direct_reference.pose: Waterfront straight toward Flyer, right corner then leftward transition beneath/along the concrete road deck. Soffit beams and forked piers are visible to the driver LEFT during the exit.
direct_reference.station_registration: Landmark and actual mapped bridge alignment, approximately 4250–4365 m with ±60 m source-pose uncertainty. The camera is forward cockpit throughout. No proportional playback-time station interpolation.
direct_reference.cut_warning: 1257 s is a trackside camera and1260 s is another lap. These do not form an exact forward MBS-facing pair.
direct_reference.source_geometry: Closed pale concrete slab, repeated longitudinal underside beams, forked supporting piers and solid top-edge parapets.

section_estimates.pier_geometry: A concrete shaft branches to two sloping arms beneath a transverse pier head. Support candidates intersecting racing protection or existing buildings are omitted rather than placed in the driving corridor. Exact engineering bay positions are not surveyed.
section_estimates.scope: Local retained carriageway segments only. Their finite ends reflect the retained way bounds; this is not a reconstruction of the entire elevated expressway.

ground_reconstruction.geometry: Only the estimated deck footprints generated from the actual retained street axes and lane tags, minus water and permanent building footprints.
ground_reconstruction.reason: The DSM reaches14–17 m under the known elevated road, while direct cockpit footage shows an open street-level underside. Retaining that duplicated elevated-deck height as ground would bury the supports.
ground_reconstruction.method: Adjacent canonical street height at native4290 plus0.10 m is a reconstructed low ground pad under the deck. All native road geometry remains authoritative and unchanged. This scenery height is an estimate, not a ground survey.
ground_reconstruction.ambiguity_policy: No changes to the mall, Gardens-by-the-Bay layer2 pedestrian approach, Bayfront Bridge or their uncertain land levels. Earlier absent-frontage and definitive roof-spill claims remain withdrawn.

intended_road_overlap.description: Real overhead ramp/carriageway geometry across the earlier Republic Boulevard street arm and the Flyer corner exit. These are explicitly allowed elevated structures, not accidental grandstand/roof road intrusions.

physical_changes: None. Racing XYZ, width/elevation/banking, protection, track limits, driving surfaces, camera and handling are untouched. All new geometry uses existing Road/Concrete/Steel materials.

lighting.range_semantics: Transition start, low plateau start, plateau end, transition end. Cubic smoothstep transitions preserve the original15.5 m height outside these two local ranges.
lighting.field_explanation: Actual circuit_art irradiance uses fixture XY, nearest road frame/height, pool radius and power, not fixture Z. All these inputs are byte-identical, so its full radiance/elevation arrays and road-field texture remain exactly unchanged. Power stays0.23 and pool11m; applying an extra inverse-square change would alter an already-calibrated field.
lighting.compatibility: Actual non-Singapore lighting function ASTs are unchanged; original heights outside these two dips, including Anderson Bridge, are identical.
